lesson-intro.text: A pineapple wears a spiky crown of leaves, and its skin is covered in diamonds. Body first, then the crown, then the diamonds. Watch it get dressed up, then give yours a crown too.

body.text: The body is a tall oval, like an egg standing up. From the top, curve down the left side.

body-2.text: Then the right side, curving down to meet it at the bottom.

middle-leaf.text: The crown starts with its tallest leaf, standing straight up in the middle.

inner-leaves.text: Add a leaf on each side of it, leaning out a little.

low-leaves.text: Two long leaves curl out low, one to the left and one to the right.

back-leaves.text: Two more leaves poke up from behind. They fill the gaps.

hatch-one.text: Now the diamond pattern. Draw four slanted lines across the body, all leaning the same way.

hatch-two.text: Four more lines lean the other way and cross them. Diamonds everywhere.

green.text: Color most of the leaves green.

dark-green.text: The two leaves beside the middle one are dark green.

lesson-outro.text: A spiky crown and diamond skin. Your pineapple looks sweet, and just a little bit prickly.
